ingredients.raw: 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breasts about 4 pieces
ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts

instructions.text: Add the chicken, soy sauce, honey, hoisin sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, and garlic to the slow cooker. Stir until well combined.
Cook in the slow cooker for 3-4 hours on high or 6-7 hours on low. Make sure to flip the chicken breast over when cooked halfway.
Once fully cooked, shred the chicken. I use a hand mixer for easy shredding. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Remove from slow cooker and top with scallions and sesame seeds. Serve with rice or other side dishes.
